method: Built the current Beta4 source before Beta5 production edits; real playtest UI, real pointer drags, seven cross-world shots plus two deterministic paused-clock replays. No injected projectile/actor state. Screenshots inspected manually.

findings.title: Flank impact teleports anvil onto enemy head
findings.observed: At t=.60 anvil centre is (889.39,593.23) moving right at 1270px/s, at target body height. By .65 it snaps to (960,555) and speed zero, remaining static for five seconds. This was a side impact, not a landing from above.
findings.sourceCause: restAnvilOnEnemy is called after any damaging enemy contact without a downward/top contact check.

findings.title: Ground drilling state persists through empty air
findings.observed: After drilling overhead red masonry, x remains1079.17 while the anvil floats down an open room. Speed stays209.84px/s and removed count stays480 between y427.89 and585.27.
findings.sourceCause: plunging is retained after the drill leaves material, so constant downward drill velocity overrides normal gravity in air.

findings.title: Anvil intersects the opening Shulker lid
findings.observed: The anvil remains fixed at the closed48px physics-box head height. Shulker lid opens through it, leaving the anvil embedded in the lid.
findings.sourceCause: Head placement uses enemy dimensions.height only, while native animated shell lid extends above that physics box.

otherObservations: Ordinary Nether/Sift ground drilling was visible and gradual; no broad icon-quality issue or invisible anvil was observed. End10 obsidian pylon ricochet was physically plausible. No console startup errors occurred.
